card.title: Hand It Over
card.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the seating plan. You've put the exes together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they can be civil from separate tables.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the pencil. I'll preserve the hours and move the chairs.

mechanism: A tries to take over a flawed seating plan by separating respect for B's effort from control of the actual placements.
confusable: Unlike making one suggestion, A must seek the means to perform the corrections themself.
comparison: D36-b takes the pencil after acknowledging hours; D36-a takes the screwdriver while conceding public credit.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
